name: Fractera Config
summary: The project settings of the node as its own element: APP, PLATFORM and DESIGN settings and the menu live here, the architect edits them here, every element reads them here.

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-24699. Ask the node, never remember.

runtime.note: server.js is the service (node:http). `npm run build` = the route guard + the site (presentation/, Next 16 Cache Components) into the folder NEXT_DIST_DIR names; `.presentation-dist` marks it. Pages are data folders in presentation/content (skill use-page-tree).

doors.gives: the public home page of the element
search signals; the sitemap lists pages only once the element has a real public address
MCP: the project settings as commands for an agent

languages.note: The public home page speaks en and ru.
